content: .{@-णाचिकेतः@} .²1 a part of the Adhvaryu-sacrifice or Yajurveda, or one who performs a vow connected therewith (according to <ls>Kull.</ls> on <ls>Ms. 3. 185</ls>); <ls>Mb. 13. 90. 26</ls>. .²2 one who has thrice kindled the Nāchiketa fire or studied the Nāchiketa section of Kāṭhaka; त्रिणाचिकेत- -स्त्रिभिरेत्य सन्धिम् <ls>Kaṭh. 1. 17</ls>.
